scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv sync --directory backend
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory backend fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.serve: uv run --directory backend fastapi run app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest -q && npm --prefix frontend test
